• Feature impact: user engagement and performance metrics for high-complexity features you own, including adoption rates, performance benchmarks, and production stability

• Architectural decisions: adoption and success of technical approaches you champion, measured through feature reliability, performance gains, and team consensus

• Cross-functional influence: successful delivery of initiatives requiring coordination across Product, AI Services, and other engineering teams with clear outcomes and minimal friction

title: Back-End Software Engineer (.NET)
description:

Cafeyn is more than a platform- it is transforming the way people access and experience content. Since 2006, we’ve grown in a fast-evolving market, adapting to become a leading digital reading service with over 2 million users worldwide. Cafeyn gives readers unlimited, personalized access to thousands of newspapers and magazines, curated to fit their tastes and delivered seamlessly across devices.
Our mission?
To empower individuals with access to trusted, high-quality content that fosters personal growth and discovery. Whether it's through the comprehensive collection of news and features on Cafeyn , the digital publishing solutions of Milibris, the fun and educative content for children on Kidjo, or the collections for manga lovers by Mangas.io, Cafeyn stands at the forefront of digital content experiences.
Your team & responsibilities
You will join the Tech team - Back End team composed of a team of over 10 developers to ensure the robustness, scalability, performance, and security of the company’s back-end systems.
Your missions

• Participate in the development of APIs and other back-end components.

• Ensure the operation and maintenance as well as the evolution of existing systems.

• Participate in technical design of our back-end systems.

• Ensure all phases of development, code review, versioning, documentation and maintenance.

• Write unit tests, follow code naming and coding style rules, participate in code reviews.

• Respect the methods and processes put in place (agile methodology).

• Ensure a permanent technological watch on its technological sector in order to be able to quickly detect emerging technical solutions and software bricks (Open Source, market software, etc.) that can be integrated into the company's roadmap.

Who are we looking for?
You are at the right place if you have

• 3+ years of experience on a similar role

• Strong working knowledge of C # (.Net Core framework)

• SQL experience

• Strong knowledge of REST APIs and/or gRPC

• Experience with development tools, source management and CI/CD

• Experience in performance optimization, unit tests and best practice

• Product vision

• Team play and strong sense of cross collaboration

• Bilingual in French and English

This position is open to full remote (France).

• HR Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Manager (30’)

• Hiring manager Interview with our Back end Manager, David.

• Live case study & peer interview with our Back end team.

• Last Interview with our Director of Engineering, Vincent.

Perks & benefits of working at Cafeyn

We provide a Swile card for your meal vouchers, Sidecare health insurance, and a mobility package to reimburse your transport subscription.

• Sports 🏃

We have a partnership with Wellpass that gives you access to fitness classes and wellness activities for both exercise and relaxation as you want.

You have an access to our mental health platform teale , where you can book appointments with your psychologist or monitor your mental health.

• Hybrid policy 🏠

We allow you to work remotely two days per week.

• Cafeyn ’s access 🗞️

We provide you with a VIP code for Cafeyn , giving you unlimited access to all content on our platform.

• Team life 🪅

We organize four office meet-ups per year. These occasions allow us to gather with our international offices, celebrate company updates, and spend quality time together.

description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle ’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .
What you’ll be part of:
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
What you'll be responsible for
Circle 's Payments engineering organization builds the infrastructure that moves value across the Circle Payments Network (CPN) and Managed Payments, connecting banks, payment service providers (PSPs), and fintechs to fast, low-cost, always-on cross-border settlement in USDC and EURC. As Engineering Manager, Payments, you'll lead a team responsible for backend systems that power financial institution onboarding, payment orchestration, and bulk payment processing. You'll be accountable for the delivery, reliability, security, and financial correctness of systems that move customer funds at scale, while developing a high-performing engineering team and partnering closely with stakeholders across Circle .

What you'll work on

• Lead the day-to-day execution of an engineering team, including planning, prioritization, delivery, and continuous improvement of team processes.

• Provide technical and architectural direction for payment orchestration, ledger and reconciliation systems, and bank or PSP integrations handling high transaction volumes.

• Partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Solutions Engineering to define roadmaps and deliver cross-border payouts, managed stablecoin settlement, and bulk payment capabilities.

• Own engineering delivery for key Payments initiatives, including regulated and managed payments expansion, while coordinating effectively across India- and US-based teams.

• Ensure the reliability, security, operational readiness, and financial correctness of payment-critical systems, including incident response and on-call practices.

• Recruit, coach, and develop engineers while owning performance management, career development, feedback, and promotion processes for direct reports.

• Drive engineering goals aligned to Payments business outcomes, including geographic expansion, transaction growth, customer experience, and reliable market launches across APAC and Africa.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core Requirements

• 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years of experience managing or formally leading software engineering teams.

• Experience designing, building, and operating distributed, highly available backend systems in production environments.

• Experience building or operating payments, banking, or financial transaction systems such as payment orchestration, ledgers, reconciliation, or settlement.

• Strong hands-on technical leadership skills, including architecture reviews, system design, technical trade-off discussions, and code-level guidance.

• Proficiency in one or more backend programming languages such as Java, Go, or Kotlin.

• Experience recruiting, coaching, developing, and performance-managing engineers, including senior-level individual contributors.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to partner effectively with Product, Compliance, Risk

• Develop final production-ready samples of 12-18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.

• Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.

• Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.

• Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.

• Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.

• 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.

• Experience taking products from concept to mass production.

• Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.

• Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.

The problem it solves is real and measurable. Engineering teams wrapped every model call in an SDK, threaded metadata through every request, or enforced tagging standards that shared GPUs and single-account model APIs were defeated by design. Cached, reasoning, input, and output tokens are split automatically. The result is token economics that holds up to audit, with zero engineering effort to produce or maintain.

You'll own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments - finding the right prospects, running compelling solution pitches, navigating technical objections alongside our engineers, and closing complex partnerships end to end.

You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.

Our global professional community boasts 60,000 full- and part-time alumni - and counting. In addition to fostering career growth for individuals, GA helps employers cultivate top tech talent and spur innovation by transforming their teams through strategic learning. More than 21,000 employees at elite companies worldwide have honed their digital fluency with our upskilling and reskilling initiatives. GA has also been recognized as one of Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500, and Fast Company has dubbed us leaders in World-Changing Ideas as well as the #1 Most Innovative Company in Education.

GA is at the leading edge of creating practical solutions to one of the most pressing challenges of our time - the future of work. As recognized by The World Economic Forum, BCG, the OECD and more, these are big challenges to which only a few companies are offering real solutions. As a Senior Learning Experience Designer (LED), you will be responsible for designing, developing, and
contextualizing high-quality GA learning programs for enterprise, technical, and professional audiences.
This role requires strong learning experience design knowledge, excellent program development and
project management skills, and hands-on fluency with AI tools and emerging workplace technologies.
You will create practical, outcome-driven learning experiences that help learners build relevant skills and
apply them with confidence in real workplace contexts. Because AI is increasingly embedded across GA
programs and client needs, you should understand how modern AI tools are actually used in the
workplace and be able to translate that fluency into applied activities, labs, simulations, facilitator guides,
assessments, and client-specific adaptations.

While this role will contribute significantly to GA’s AI-enabled and emerging technology portfolio, it is
not a purely AI curriculum role. The core responsibility is to create scalable, high-quality GA programs
that meet learner needs, client goals, market expectations, and GA’s instructional standards.
You will project manage and collaborate with subject matter experts, instructors, product managers,
learning designers, assessment specialists, vendors, and client-facing teams to create learning experiences
that reflect current market needs, emerging capabilities, and practical workplace application.

Key Responsibilities:
Program Ownership & Discovery
● Serve as the Lead Learning Experience Designer for GA programs that may include AI, emerging
technology, digital transformation, technical skills, leadership, role-based application, or
workplace productivity components.

project timelines, scope, resourcing, development plans, and content quality from discovery
through delivery.
● Partner with sales, product, client success, solutions, and delivery teams to identify client and
learner needs and translate those needs into practical learning solutions.

program objectives, audience readiness, and recommended learning pathways.
● Evaluate the tools, workflows, use cases, and workplace contexts most relevant to a client or
learner audience, including AI tools where relevant, and determine how they should be
represented in the learning experience.
● Define clear learning outcomes that move learners from awareness to practical application,
workflow improvement

description:

Benefits

• $800-$1,200 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated output quality

• Rate reviewed at 90 days based on deadline adherence, revision rates, brand consistency, and producer feedback

title: Hospitality Associate
description:
About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities - and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

Location: New Orleans, Louisiana 

Time Commitment: Approximately 32-40 hours 

Anticipated Schedule: Flexible - including nights, weekends, and holidays.

The Role

The Hospitality Associate role is an on-site facilitator of everything that the Kasa guest will experience during their stay. As a Hospitality Associate in the New Orleans market, you will have end-to-end ownership over the guest experience onsite.

Like many operations roles, there is no “typical day” but you will collaborate daily with Kasa teams and partners to drive excellent guest service and results. You will be actively communicating through text, phone, email, WhatsApp, Slack, all while prioritizing guest needs and delivering phenomenal service. Daily tasks include, but are not limited to: Checking guests in, assisting with local area recommendations, communicating and prioritizing with Housekeeping, working seamlessly with our regional GX team, identifying upsell and revenue opportunities, maintaining the lobby and hotel vibe, addressing any guest needs, touring the property and assisting guests to their unit, and delivering 5-star service to guests and other team members. A typical schedule for this role is based on business needs, including nights, weekends and holidays (we are in the hospitality industry).

Unleash your career potential at Kasa

We're building a tech-enabled global hospitality brand that unleashes the potential of livable space. Hospitality is at the core of who we are, and we are committed to providing our teams the same care we give our guests, neighbors, and partners.

Required Attributes

• Guest-Centric Mindset: Multiple years of experience in a hospitality or service industry working backward from the guests’ needs to deliver positive experiences and interactions.

• Proactive Communicator: Delivers clear, concise, and proactive communication across teams and external partners. Leads by example in resolving misunderstandings and promoting seamless collaboration.

• Tech Savvy: Proficient with modern technology tools and effectively uses them to complete daily work.

• Reliable & Consistent: Takes pride in arriving to work on time and welcomes the opportunity to work nights and weekends.

• Handy: Comfortable with using a toolkit, physically and metaphorically. Approaching ‘problems’ as opportunities and showing the initiative to devise solutions.

• Functional Self-Management: Works with minimal supervision, manages own time effectively, maintains control over all current projects/responsibilities.

• Change Advocate: Thrive in an environment with constant change and easily adapts to new processes, technology, and/or procedures that impact day-to-day responsibilities.

• Process Minded: Effectively executes established processes with precision and surfaces process deficiencies which negatively impact the guest experience.

description:

Enabling millions of distributed energy devices to deliver reliable and predictable grid services to the electricity industry requires state-of-the-art forecasting, control systems, optimization algorithms, and data science. As such, EnergyHub seeks to hire a Senior Forecasting and Optimization Engineer to join EnergyHub ’s Data Science and Power Systems Intelligence team. As a Senior Forecasting and Optimization Engineer you will work closely with some of the brightest minds in the electricity industry to solve some of the most difficult problems in distributed energy. The algorithms and data systems that you contribute to will be key to enabling a carbon-free distributed energy future.
Main Responsibilities: What you’ll do

• Develop and improve accurate and robust energy forecasting models

• Develop and improve control and optimization algorithms

• Design, write, test, and deploy production-grade code for mission-critical forecasting and optimization products and related algorithms

• Build and use tools and processes to monitor and assess the quality of operational forecasting and optimization models

• Translate data from one of the largest distributed energy datasets in the electricity industry into actionable insights for electric utilities and other energy industry stakeholders

• Provide guidance to other engineers and scientists regarding machine learning, forecasting and optimization methods

• Present results clearly to internal and external stakeholders

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders inside and outside of EnergyHub including Data Engineering, Client Success, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Market Development teams

• Other duties as assigned

• At least five years of experience in machine learning, statistical analysis, data visualization, control systems engineering, and/or mathematical optimization

• Experience developing data pipelines using large-scale relational databases

• Strong mathematical skills, with the ability to apply new mathematical techniques to real-world problems

• At least three years of hands-on experience with Python and the scientific and machine learning tool stack (Pandas, Numpy, SciPy, Sklearn, PyTorch, and Tensorflow)

• An ability to find valuable insights in large, complex datasets

• Ability to explain results from large-scale data analyses to diverse audiences in a way that is clear, interesting, and actionable

• Ability to have fun while working on really hard problems with really smart people

Preferred Skills and Experience: Nice-to-haves

• Experience bringing long-term research projects, such as an MS or PhD thesis, to a successful conclusion

• Experience developing control and optimization solutions for large-scale problems

• Experience building large-scale forecasting and machine learning products in the cloud (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks)

• A strong background in mathematics and statistics

• Experience using Large Language Models to accelerate software development and reliably add new capabilities to real products

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

- Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

- Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

- Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the role:

Angi is seeking an exceptional Senior Data Scientist to help build our agent suite for Pros, AI software that automates and runs the Pro's business for them. The first product in the suite is an AI voice and SMS agent that contacts homeowners on the Pro's behalf, qualifies the job, and books the appointment. It is live with hundreds of Pros and growing, and it is the first of several agents we intend to build.

This is a data science role on a product whose core behavior is conversational and probabilistic. The work spans shaping how the agent behaves, building the evaluation systems that tell us whether it is getting better, designing the experiments that decide what we ship, and modeling the parts of the lead to job completion journey where a model is the right answer. Success in the role shows up directly in improving Pro’s revenue, which is the metric that determines whether Pros see a return from Angi.

 

What you’ll do:

- Agent Behavior & Development: Lead improvements to how our agents converse, qualify, and book, through conversation design, prompting, and campaign logic. Success in these areas directly impacts contact rate, engagement rate, appointment set rate, and job win rate which are critical metrics for both Pro outcomes and business success.

- Evaluation & Measurement: Build the evaluation systems that make agent quality measurable, spanning automated checks over conversation traces, simulated conversations graded against expected outcomes, and model-based evaluation where human judgment is required. Establish the frameworks and design of experiment practices we use to decide what ships.

- Conversation Analysis: Work directly with real conversations to understand where the agent succeeds and where it falls short, translating that understanding into a shared taxonomy of failure modes, measured rates, and a prioritized path to improvement.

- Modeling & Production Ownership: Develop predictive models where they add leverage, in areas such as qualification and appointment quality, homeowner engagement, and channel and timing selection, and take them into production yourself. This team builds and operates what it designs, so your work runs in our production systems with the monitoring and testing that implies.

- Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with a strong team of engineers, product managers, designers and operations partners to build scalable and high-impact solutions. Collaborate on the end-to-end development process, from ideation to deployment, ensuring that data-driven solutions are seamlessly integrated into our products and services.

- Innovation: Foster innovation within the team, exploring new approaches and techniques to solve complex business problems.

- Mentorship: Guide junior team members and foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. Lead and encourage innovation and knowledge sharing to enhance the team's capabilities in advanced data science techniques from both industry and academia.

 

Who you are:

- You have a Master's or Ph.D. in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields), or equivalent practical experience.

- You have 4+ years of experience in data science and machine learning, ideally within the tech industry and marketplace environments.

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

We're now entering our next growth cycle - accelerating internationalization beyond Latin America and expanding into new verticals beyond financial services.

Here's the question this role exists to answer: as Nubank moves from a Latin American digital bank into a globally distributed company operating across dozens of jurisdictions and new verticals - competing simultaneously for regulated banking talent and frontier tech talent - how do we build a Rewards architecture that scales without fragmenting, stays competitive, efficient & effective, and reinforces a single culture across radically different labor markets?

The frameworks that took us from zero to over 135M customers across three countries are not the frameworks that will take us to 40+ markets. You will be the person who decides what scales, what gets rebuilt, and what gets retired.

Why this matters: Compensation, benefits, equity, and executive pay are the contracts we write with every person we hire - and at our scale, those contracts are also the operating system that determines where we can grow, how fast, and at what cost. This isn't a function that administers programs handed down by the business. It's the function that decides what's possible.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You will lead global compensation, benefits, wellness, and executive compensation end-to-end, sit on the Executive Committee, and partner directly with our CEO and CHRO on the most consequential people decisions we make: site location strategy, M&A diligence, market entry, AI transformation, and the deals that secure the leaders defining Nubank's next chapter.

- Design the global Rewards architecture - compensation, benefits, wellness, and executive compensation - coherent globally, adaptable locally, built to scale from 3 markets to 40+.

- Partner on globalization and M&A, including site location, deal structuring, and post-merger integration. Bring the Rewards lens on the right talent strategy across the globe.

- Operate at the People leadership team partnering directly with the CEO and CHRO on executive compensation, equity design, and senior leadership talent strategy.

- Own the relationship with our Compensation Committee chair and Board members on executive comp and governance.

- Lead with data - assess effectiveness, guide design, and demonstrate impact in language the business understands.

- Shape the people implications of AI transformation - how AI changes job architecture, critical talent needs, workforce planning, and the reward mechanisms that reinforce the capabilities Nubank needs next.

- Build and develop your team, fostering ownership and continuous improvement in a high-velocity environment.

Rewards is the non-negotiable core of this role. Depending on your background, scope may also extend into other disciplines.

- 10+ years leading global Total Rewards functions in complex, multi-country environments.

- Deep expertise in compensation, benefits, and executive compensation design.

- Experience in high-growth or tech-driven organizations - you know what breaks when a company scales fast.

- A track record leading large-scale organizational change through complex, cross-functional projects.

- The communication range to make complex trade-offs clear and compelling to a C-level and Board audience.

- A strategic, data-driven mindset - and the operational discipline to actually ship the work, not just design it.

title: Co-Founder in Residence, Turning Plastic Waste into Circular Olefins
description:
The Problem Worth Solving
300 million tonnes of plastic waste are produced every year. Most of it - especially polyolefins like polypropylene - can't be meaningfully recycled. It's one of the largest unsolved problems in materials science, and no one has cracked it at scale. Until now.
The Venture
We're developing a novel electrified process that transforms polyolefin waste into high-value packaging materials - polypropylene-grade performance with dramatically better end-of-life characteristics, including solvolysis recyclability and designed-in environmental degradability. This isn't incremental improvement. It's a platform with the potential to become a global polyolefin sink.
The recycled polyolefin market is worth $60B+ and accelerating. EU regulations mandate recycled polymer content in food packaging by 2030. Brand owners are scrambling for circular solutions. There's no clear winner yet.
The Role
We're looking for a Commercial Co-Founder to own everything from customer to capital. You'll partner with the technical founder to take this from pre-seed to Series A and beyond - validating markets, landing anchor customers, securing feedstock supply, and building the commercial infrastructure that turns a breakthrough technology into a durable business.
This is a ground-floor co-founder role. You'll hold a majority equity stake in the company alongside your co-founder(s), with pre-seed investment and ongoing support from Deep Science Ventures .
What You'll Own

• Customer discovery and market prioritisation - from cold outreach to binding offtake agreements

• Feedstock supply partnerships with waste management companies

• Strategic partnerships with compounders, distributors, and brand owners

• Techno-economic modelling and pricing strategy alongside the technical founder

• Fundraising - leading commercial due diligence, building investor relationships, and closing rounds

• Company strategy as a core member of the founding team

• Building and leading the commercial team as you scale

Requirements
Who We're Looking For
Someone who has done the 0-to-1 journey before. You've co-founded or commercially led a startup from inception, raised VC funding, and personally closed early deals. Experience in circular economy, materials, chemicals, or sustainability is a strong differentiator - but the right founder with a different domain background and the hunger to learn is equally compelling. Above all, you thrive in ambiguity, make decisions fast with imperfect information, and are motivated by building something with genuine climate impact.
Essential:

• Experienced founder/operator, with proven commercial track record in materials, chemicals, packaging, or adjacent industrial sectors - from cold outreach to signed deals

• Experience in an early-stage or startup environment; comfortable owning outcomes with limited resources

• Strong financial literacy - able to build, interrogate, and communicate financial models

• Experience fundraising from VC

• Excellent stakeholder communication - credible with customers, investors, and a technical co-founder alike

Valuable:

• Network across plastics, packaging or waste management industries

• Familiarity with circular economy trends, recycling value chains and EU regulatory frameworks

• Experience managing application testing programmes or go-to-market strategy in materials

• Background in regulatory pathways for chemicals or materials

Benefits
The Setup
This role is structured as a Founder in Residence through Deep Science Ventures , with the venture targeting incorporation and spin-out asap. The venture spins out with £250k in inception capital from DSV and Valterra Platinum (formerly Anglo American Platinum). Majority equity stake between you and your co-founder(s) and salary is negotiated as part of the spin-out. Post-launch, DSV provides continuous support - fundraising, partnerships, recruitment. Remote-first, open globally, with a preference for UK/Europe.

title: Delivery Capacity & Demand Manager (f/m/x)
description:
About the role: What's in the Box

Every day, a defined set of rules decides what every new HelloFresh customer sees: a unique mix of delivery days, prices and recommended selections. Your job, should you choose to accept it, is to keep that rule-set correct in a constantly moving environment: configuring it, checking it daily, documenting it, and fixing exceptions before a misconfiguration reaches a customer or a warehouse. 

You'll join Demand Steering , the team within Network Operations Europe that shapes those offerings so they add up to a plan our warehouses and logistics partners can actually execute. That means balancing what customers want against the real constraints of the journey from click to delivery: every box still has to be produced in a shift at a production facility and delivered by a van on a route.

Using our in-house demand steering tool, you'll configure the delivery offering customers see at checkout across your own set of European markets: which delivery days and time windows are offered, at what price, with which recommendation, and to which customer segment. As technical owner of that configuration, you'll balance demand against capacity: working with supply chain planners, local market teams and our tech partners to validate holiday shifts and peak periods, check daily that the offering behaved as intended, and catch misconfigurations before a customer or a warehouse feels them..

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Own the delivery proposition for your set of European markets: the delivery days, time windows, cut-offs, pricing nudges and recommendations customers see when they place or change an order.

• Configure and calibrate our in-house demand steering tool, so demand is guided towards the capacity we have rather than blocked outright when a production site or delivery route fills up.

• Monitor daily whether the offering ran as expected across your markets, and get to the bottom of it when it didn't: a data pipeline that stalled, a setting that's off, or a shift in how customers are behaving.

• Dig into the data with SQL and our monitoring dashboards to establish what actually happened,.

• Make it make sense to turn technical outcomes into a clear story for colleagues who don't live inside the tool.

• Partner with supply chain planners, logistics teams, local market colleagues and our tech partners to translate their constraints into configurations, and to flag early where a forecast and a delivery plan are heading for a collision.

• Lead the validation for holiday shifts and peak periods, giving a clear go/no-go recommendation backed by evidence rather than instinct.

• Shape where the tool goes next, improving the configurations, checks and documentation that keep demand steering reliable as we roll the model out across more markets.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• Experience in logistics, supply chain, operations or a related field, where you've seen how a change to what you offer customers affects their journey

• Confidence with data: you write your own SQL queries, work comfortably in spreadsheets, and read a dashboard closely enough to tell a real signal from noise.

• A methodical way of working: you like things documented and done properly, and you stay effective while the system around you is still being built out.

• The ability to explain a technical problem to a non-technical colleague, and to make a recommendation land with evidence behind it.

• An appetite for ownership over the long haul: you'd rather take one system and develop true mastery in it than move from project to project.

• Fluent English, and you're based in Berlin or ready to move there.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

title: Head of Pharmacovigilance
description:
Location:   This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Head of Clinical Sciences, the Head of Pharmacovigilance (PV) is a physician who builds and leads Praxis’s in-house pharmacovigilance function across clinical development and commercial products. Praxis is building its pharmacovigilance system in-house rather than outsourcing it, and is using an AI-enabled safety database to create an efficient case-handling process. The Head of PV owns that system and the team that runs it.

The function is organized in two parts. Pharmacovigilance for programs in clinical development is led by the PV Clinical Development Lead, who reports to the Head of PV, leads a dedicated clinical trial safety team, and carries day-to-day medical safety oversight of the clinical-stage portfolio. Pharmacovigilance for commercial products is held directly by the Head of PV, who is personally accountable for postmarketing safety surveillance, reporting, and benefit-risk, and who directly leads the commercial-product Medical Reviewer and PV Scientist. The PV Operations Lead supports both parts of the function. Across both, the Head of PV is accountable for the pharmacovigilance system as a whole, sets the standards and governance that the two parts operate under, and is the final safety decision-maker for the company.

The safety database will already be built and validated. What this role takes on is a system that needs enhancement and modification as new products advance and launch, a quality system that has to keep pace with it, and a team that has to be assembled and qualified. The Head of PV understands pharmacovigilance operations well enough to direct them and to judge whether they are working, but does not carry them personally; the PV Operations Lead is engaged for that and is involved throughout.

The role is accountable, not advisory. The Head of PV owns the pharmacovigilance system, expedited and periodic reporting compliance, the conclusions and submission of the aggregate safety reports, and the integrity of the signal management process, and defends them to health authorities. As the senior safety physician, the Head of PV personally holds the medical determinations that sit at the center of the function for commercial products, and holds final authority over those made for clinical development programs: benefit-risk, signal adjudication, and complex case causality. The Head of PV works collaboratively with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, Data Science, and Commercial to ensure comprehensive safety oversight of Praxis products.

 

Primary Responsibilities

Leadership of the PV Function

• Lead the pharmacovigilance function as a whole, accountable for the pharmacovigilance system, its quality, and its compliance across clinical development and commercial products.

• Directly lead pharmacovigilance for commercial products, including the commercial-product Medical Reviewer and PV Scientist, holding personal accountability for postmarketing safety surveillance, expedited and periodic reporting, signal management, and benefit-risk.

• Oversee pharmacovigilance for clinical development programs through the PV Clinical Development Lead and the clinical trial safety team reporting to that role: set expectations, standards, and escalation criteria; review the safety positions taken; and retain final authority over program-significant safety decisions.

• Ensure the clinical development and commercial parts of the function operate as one system, with a single quality system, a single safety database, consistent medical judgment across both teams, and a clean handover of safety accountability as products move from development to market.

Senior Medical Determinations

• Make and articulate the benefit-risk determination for each commercial product in aggregate rep

**ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique - with a patent filing already in progress. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company - which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability.

title: Strategic Alliances Lead
description:
Description:
The Strategic Alliances Lead will play a pivotal role in building and nurturing partnerships with our thought leaders, patient advocacy groups, and academic institutions. This individual will focus on advancing initiatives for our CNS portfolio: Headache disorders and Parkinson's Disease (PD). By collaborating with our cross-functional teams, the Strategic Alliances Lead will drive strategic engagement efforts that support the company's mission, enhance product awareness, and deliver impactful resources for healthcare providers and patients.
Essential Functions:

• Thought Leader Engagement: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) in Headache disorders and Parkinson’s disease; Collaborate with KOLs to support scientific exchange, educational programs, and awareness initiatives; Identify and prioritize opportunities for collaboration, such as advisory board follow-up, planned speaking engagements and attendance at scientific congresses

• Patient Advocacy and Community Engagement: Serve as the regional liaison to patient advocacy organizations in the Headache disorder and Parkinson’s disease space, ensuring alignment with shared goals and initiatives; Partner with advocacy groups to support educational campaigns, patient access initiatives and community outreach program; Represent the company at relevant advocacy events, conferences and forums to build awareness and strengthen relationships

• Academic Partnerships and Neurology Fellowship Programs: Cultivate relationships with academic centers to support and expand movement disorders and headache programs; Collaborate with institutions to maximize educational resources and opportunities tailored to emerging healthcare professionals; Facilitate partnerships that align with corporate goals, enhancing the reach and impact of the company’s neurology portfolio.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a resource to CNS Regional Sales Managers and sales representatives, providing strategic guidance, insights, and tools to support field-based initiatives; Work closely with Sales Training, Commercial Marketing, and Medical Affairs teams to launch impactful resources and training materials; Collaborate with Compliance to ensure all initiatives align with regulatory requirements and company policies; Partner with Commercial Operations to track and measure the success of key programs and initiatives.

• Support for Product Launch and Portfolio Promotion: Assist in the launch and ongoing promotion of the company’s new headache therapy, while supporting our existing Parkinson’s Disease portfolio; Develop and execute strategic plans to optimize product awareness and uptake in both therapeutic areas.

title: Enterprise Strategy Manager
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Enterprise Strategy Manager to join our Montreal team at Lightspeed. This role will support enterprise and business strategy efforts by conducting analysis, developing insights, and helping teams make data-driven decisions. As Lightspeed enters its next phase of growth and a multi-year transformation, this role will help shape and support key strategic priorities across the business. The ideal candidate brings strong strategic thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

What you'll be doing:

- Support enterprise and business strategy efforts through research, analysis, and insight development, including contributing to annual strategic planning and ongoing strategic review cadences

- Break down complex business problems and conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis

- Build models, synthesize data, and develop materials to support executive-level decision-making

- Contribute to the development of business cases, plans, and recommendations

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather inputs and support the execution of key initiatives

- Help track progress and performance of initiatives against key milestones and targets

What you need to bring:

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail

- Ability to structure problems and work through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment

- Comfort working with data and translating findings into clear insights

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and functions

- Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and take ownership

- As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

- 3-5 years of experience in consulting, strategy, finance, or a related field

- Experience working on structured problem-solving engagements (e.g., strategy, operations, or transformation projects)

- Internship or early-career experience involving data analysis and business problem solving

- Experience in SaaS, fintech, or other technology-driven environments

You’ll enjoy:

- A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

- A culture that celebrates performance

- The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

- Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

- Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

- Equity options, because this is your company too

- Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

- Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

- Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

- Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

- Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

- Computer purchase program to get your personal MacBook

- Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud
